title: Elon Musk's Unbelievably Simple 12-minute Killer Break Down on Climate Change
summary: Elon Musk gives students at the Sorbonne a short, simple explanation of climate change and carbon emissions shortly before the 2015 COP21 conference in Paris. He covers why CO2 accumulation matters and argues for a carbon tax.
why: Cited as evidence that Musk has long taken climate change seriously and as a concise statement of his views on carbon pricing.

quote.text: If you think Musk doesn't care about Earth problems, check this out
